caseNameFull: E. B. Howard, as Auditor of the State of Oklahoma v. Gipsy Oil Company E. B. Howard, as Auditor of the State of Oklahoma v. Indian Territory Illuminating Oil Company E. B. Howard, as Auditor of the State of Oklahoma v. Oklahoma Oil Company and E. B. Howard, as Auditor of the State of Oklahoma v. Barnsdall Oil Company
summary: Appeals from the District Court of the United States for the Western District of Oklahoma.
attorneys: Mr. R. E. Wood and Mr. S. P. Freeling, for appellants, submitted. Mr. James B. Diggs, Mr. Frederick de C. Faust, Mr. Charles F. Wilson, Mr. F. C. Proctor and Mr. D. E. Green for appellee in No. 245. Mr. John H. Burford, Mr. John H. Brennan, Mr. I.B. A. Robertson, Mr. Frank B. Burford and Mr. Burdette Blue for appellees in Nos. 246 and 248. No appearance for appellee in No. 247.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgments affirmed with costs upon the authority of Choctaw & Gulf R. R. Co. v. Harrison, 235 U. S. 292; Indian Territory Illuminating Oil Co. v. Oklahoma, 240 U. S. 522.
